{{Top|leg}}
'''Theloxin''' was a substance secreted within a [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an's]] body. Low theloxin levels on a Pau'an would result in the growth of a exophthalmic goiter, which would affect the anterior lobes of the lutiaary gland. The lobes produce [[roaamin]] that can cause giantism in a Pau'an.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
